simple.meaning: נְטֹפָה (Nᵉṭôphâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Netophah , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְטֹפָה (H5199) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:22, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְטֹפָה (H5199) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נְטֹפָה (H5199) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נְטֹפָה (Nᵉṭôphâh) / H5199 is traced through Ezra 2:22, Nehemiah 7:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H5199. Netophah נְטֹפָה proper name, of a location in Judah ( dropping, dripping , compare Lewy Semitic Fremdwörter 40 ); — Ezra 2:22 = Neh 7:26 ; ᵐ5 . Νετωφα , ᵐ5 L Νετωφαγι (as adjective, of a people 12:28 ).
